title: GTA 6 drops nearly 40 new screenshots before launch 📸
subject: gta6
description:
Which screenshot stood out to you? 👇

Rockstar published the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Gallery on November 5, 2026: nearly 40 new uncaptioned GTA 6 screenshots of Jason and Lucia in Leonida. Pre-loading starts November 10 and GTA 6 launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: Rockstar Newswire (Nov 5, 2026), PC Gamer (Nov 5, 2026), VGC (Nov 5, 2026), Vice (Nov 5, 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: Rockstar posted nearly 40 new GTA 6 screenshots.
The Launch Gallery went up on the Rockstar Newswire on November 5, with no captions at all.
Jason and Lucia pull armed robberies, hit dance clubs, outrun police and go scuba diving.
One shot shows Jason in tactical gear stepping off a military plane, next to a dog in combat gear.
Pre-loading starts November 10, and GTA 6 launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
